title: Otori Emu — Beware Of Thieves!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehehehe♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad they gave us permission to warn the guests about these thefts by putting on performances♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad the park gave us the green light too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
But what are we going to perform...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, we want everyone to understand what's been going on, so we'll want to do something that's short and simple.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
It's gotta be easy to understand above all else!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also... We need to try to remind them to stay calm if they do happen to run into the thief!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Stay calm, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, learning that people's things have been getting stolen would scare anyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Exactly. I know it's important to warn everyone about what's been going on, but I also want them to really enjoy their time here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It's very like you to come up with such a wonderful idea, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree.
We should do our best to not make them worry.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, something short, simple and easy to understand, but also fun and enjoyable...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Oh, did you hear?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
People's things have been disappearing.
And it's apparently been happening quite a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Oh, really? That's pretty scary...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I even heard that someone's things got stolen just yesterday. What if it happens again today...?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
What?!
Doesn't that mean the thief might be hiding in plain sight?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: People are already talking about it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There isn't much anyone can do since word can spread so quickly like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want those people to smile, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They came here wanting to have a fun time, so I don't want them to feel all sad and scared.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we try doing a quick skit for them right here...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have to improvise, but I have a feeling that it'll make things feel more real.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do an improv skit that'll make them smile and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay...
Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, let's quickly come up with some roles! Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I'll be the thief!
You play the victim, Nene, and Rui can...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Oh, these are so cute!
Wanna buy some as souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay!
Oh, but we need to be careful since someone's been stealing everyone's things...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Then, maybe we should buy these later.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah!
I am the great thief, Emuemon Otori!
All of your possessions are mine, young lady!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “S-Stop! Thief!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Do you honestly think anyone would stop after hearing that?! If you want your things back, then come get them!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Oh, is this supposed to be a skit...?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I recognize them from the posters. They're a part of the cast for the show that they were supposed to do today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Wh-What do I do...?
I've already lost sight of her...”
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What's wrong? You seem very distraught.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Oh, I'm sorry, Mr. Samurai, but my things just got stolen!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Wait, that's terrible.
Can you tell me what this thief looked like?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“She was about this tall, but very fast...
Wait, that's her!!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Oh no! You found me!”
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Freeze!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “No! You aren't going to catch me so easily!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Huh...?! She's coming this way!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Stop right there, thief! Did you really think you'd get away with this?”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Eep...!
Someone's coming from behind!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“No, you're that detective!
N-Not good!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Heh. End of the line!
You're under arrest!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The life of a criminal is seldom a long one. Now, it's time for you to face the music!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Nooo!
A pincer move! I'm trapped!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Haha. She's starting to panic!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I've never seen people do a skit so up close like this before. This is really fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
Th-There's nothing I can do!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, the moral of the story is that you need to be very careful with your belongings!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you happen to witness a theft in progress, be sure to ask a nearby ronin or detective wearing a staff badge for help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We promise to continue doing our best to keep you smiling and laughing, so please try to stay positive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, we hope you enjoy the rest of your time here at Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
We did that skit completely on the fly, but everyone seemed to really enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really hope it helps keep their spirits up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I think it's already having a positive effect. Look...!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: That was meant to be a warning about all the thefts we've been hearing about, right?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I think so. But I ended up laughing for most of it.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Me too. And the staff will help us if anything does happen, so let's just try to have fun...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Things are just so much better when everyone's smiling like this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, this park's meant to be a place where they get to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep up the momentum and keep doing more of these skits!!!
